thread:
Carmen R.: quick sketch in figma: compact "board" for trace viewer. idea: pin request cards while investigating. supports reorder, short notes, export (JSON/CSV), and copy permalink. looking for copy + discoverability + a11y feedback.
David L.: nice. prefer verb-first CTA: "Pin request". keep hover tooltip short: "Pin this request".
Sofia M.: accessibility: pin must be keyboard focusable and use aria-pressed. board should be a dialog with focus trap and restore. copy action needs aria-live announcement: "Permalink copied to clipboard."
Ishan P.: dev: client-side localStorage first behind a flag. cap to 25 pins. export streaming required for large bundles; show progress. telemetry: pin.add, pin.remove, export.start, export.complete, copy.link.
Carmen R.: placement: small header badge + collapsible dock in trace view. badge shows count and opens board. dock dismissible with ESC.
David L.: wording nit: avoid "session" in CTAs. use hint text in header: "Pins live in this browser tab only."
Sofia M.: copy final suggestions: hover tooltip "Pin this request"; button "Pin request"; board header "Board (temporary)" with accessible info button.
a11y-bot: checklist: tab order, aria-describedby for tooltips, role=dialog for board, aria-live for copy toasts, high-contrast color checks.
Carmen R.: action items: Carmen update figma with badge + dock variants; Ishan prototype localStorage/export; Sofia finalize copy; David prototype keyboard nav. aim: MVP client-only in 1 sprint. thanks!
